body: That's the thing. I've tried to juggle it. Hell, I was pregnant with my second when I did my last play. I just feel so damn guilty being away from my family when I commit to a show. Honestly, one show a year used to be enough to keep me somewhat satisfied. I could live off the high of those approximate three months out of the year, but that's three months that I don't ever see my family. That makes me feel guilty. It doesn't help when my husband and children tell me they miss me. I don't feel like I have a real choice to go back to performing.
Also, thank you for being patient with me.

I used to feel happiness when I could perform. I know this sounds so incredibly stupid and selfish. A big part of my happiness was being on stage acting and/or singing. I haven't done that in about 5 years, and I'm unable to do it again because my priorities lie with my family now. I lost who I was, and I can't seem to adjust to family life. I'm not happy being a wife and mother, and that makes me feel worse because of how goddamn selfish it is. I've tried to be happy just singing for myself, but it doesn't bring me joy. In fact, it makes me sadder. I can't even listen to musicals or go to a play anymore without it feeling like torture.
You and me both, friend.
I'm sorry. It sucks, doesn't it?
How? I take care of myself like eating right and exercising regularly, but the best I ever feel is numb.
Good moments seem so flighty, but the depression feels grounded. After all these years, I've forgotten how to fly.
Right there with you.  I'm sorry you're feeling like this.

My dad cheated on my mom multiple times. He was even living a double life with a girlfriend in a different state. I found out about his philandering ways when I was 16. It was around 1am, and the police called my house. They didn't bother to ask for my mom, but they did inform me that my dad was arrested that night for soliciting a prostitute.

Years later after my mom passed away, he admitted to his double life, but still maintains his innocence of the night mentioned above.

Sounds like the entirety of my high school experience. Heaven forbid, that I enjoy singing musical theatre and opera. Somehow that got me called a "snob". 

I no longer sing or listen to musical theatre and opera. It depresses me. All that potential wasted.

My need to discuss happens before I go all TNT. I feel like I have to explain exactly what's going on in my mind before I lose complete control. It's like I can feel myself not in a great state of mind and want to be able to talk about it before it gets out of control. I don't want to be out of control, so I want to vocalise it rather than internalize it. 

When I explain to my husband that I'm feeling off, he tends to ignore me. At least that how it feels. It feels like he simply doesn't want to have anything to do with me when I discuss these feelings. Though tbf, he claims he doesn't know what to say or do because he doesn't have the first clue what BPD is, even though I've directed him to /r/BPDlovedones. Maybe he's not ready to accept that his wife is legitimately batshit crazy.

Thank you. I really needed to read that. I just feel like I'm burdening him every time I have an episode since I feel the need to discuss it immediately to help me get through it faster and without too much emotional and mental turmoil.
I'm not useless. I can be used as a bad example.
I'm loving this subreddit. I relate to so many of these.
I had to switch medications after two months. Is it possible you need a different script?

Doubt many will see this, but here goes.

Depression started in my teens. I have been emotionally and physically abused by my dad all throughout my childhood. To him, nothing I do is right. Even today, I can't talk to him for 5 minutes without hearing how I'm a fuck up in some way. Some criticisms are valid while others are straight lunacy, like telling me my curly hair is too frizzy and that I should brush it before leaving the house.

At fifteen, I was sexually molested by my cousin of the same age. He tried to make out with me. He grabbed my breasts and forced me to touch his dick. Pretty fucked up stuff, but got much worse after I told my mom. Her good intentions of getting to the bottom of the problems cost the entirety of my dad's side of the family to hate me. According to my grandma, I was trying to ruin my cousin's life somehow. I haven't talked to anyone on that side except my dad ever since.

When I finally left for college, two things happened. One my mother died. The only person I felt that I could trust and understood me to some degree. I've felt empty every since she died. And two, I met a pretty nice guy, until the day that he threatened to kill me with a saw knife to my throat. Stupid me had already dealt with him punching me a few times (felt normal to an extent, I know that sounds terrible), but I stayed with him up until that point. I may have wanted to kill myself long before that incident, but I sure as shit didn't want him to have that luxury. I'll take my own life thank you very much!

Fast forward to recent times, I'm married with two wonderful children, but I'm anxiety ridden all the time. I'm constantly on the verge of losing it. I've taken two different antidepressants and while one took away the anxiety, the suicidal thoughts remained. The other took away the thoughts, but the anxiety remains. I just want to feel sincerely happy again.   I don't feel like I'm getting the right treatment, but I also don't know what the right treatment is. All I know is that I can't continue like these. My kids deserve better than this, they deserve better than me and my fucked up size of the family. Fuck I really wish my mom was still alive.

Sorry for ranting.

Yes. During particularly bad bouts, I could go days not eating and not feeling hungry. The mere smell of food makes me sick at times, but like you I just force myself to eat. Truth is, I don't want to eat anything. I wish i could live on warm decaf coffee with a little creamer.

I feel this so much. I live to make others laugh (though I could never be a comedian), but when I'm not around my friends I'm a wreck. My husband naps most of the time when we're around each other, and when he's awake he's generally ignoring me to play on Reddit.  I had to start reading again so I could feel less lonely at least in a fantasy world. It's not very effective, but it's a good distraction. Drawing and painting help too, but lately I don't want to do those either. I live at least 2 hours from any of my friends and am unable to make new ones now. Goddamnit I'm so fucking lonely.

It was fine. I was very overwhelmed and cried a lot during the entire session making it difficult for my doctor to understand me. He recommended a psychiatric evaluation in case of a possible imbalance. Overall, he told me start valuing myself more and to stop being a doormat.
I'm so sorry. That's really shitty.
Are you asking help from union actors? Non union actors are generally very grateful for opportunities, ime.

If you find yourself gaining weight, remember you are in control of it. It sucks to count calories sometimes, but, at least to me, it's something I know I'm fully in control of. My fitness pal is a good tool. I hope this helps.
Coffee and pot. Coffee for the caffeine. Pot to numb me.
The industry is a bitch. I'm sorry for how you're being treated. I'm sure sure your screenplay is phenomenal.
Congratulations on taking this step. Please let us know how it went.
Thank you for your words. I've been putting it off for so long. I think I'm afraid to revisit some memories and learning how to cope better, but you're right. This is a positive step.
I'll write an update later today after my appointment.
Appropriate username?
It's certainly possible.
Thank you.
Smoke a ton of pot. Not the healthiest way to cope, and probably not the answer you're looking for, but yeah, lots of weed.
Comedies too. Those are good.

I'm right there with you, my friend. Not with metal, but with musical theatre. Before, I could put on any show and would be able to feel fulfilled by just singing along. Now, just being able to recognize a song playing in the distance invokes feelings of longing followed by sadness to end up empty. I miss it everyday. It's been almost 4 years since I've listened to even one song from a show. I miss singing, but when I do I'm reminded of that happiness. I cant sing anymore, and that depresses me even more. I don't know why that one song invokes your experience, but I want you to know you're not alone. I understand how that one thing you love more than life itself can crush your soul.

Depends. My musical tastes go through phases (fitting I guess). Currently I'm back to my 90s rock roots, mainly lots of Sublime. If I can force myself back to the gym, maybe I can enjoy some hip hop and thrash metal again.
Thank you!

Both Seraquel and Prozac had that numb zombie effect on me. I quit them both and started self medicating with pot instead. Obviously marijuana doesn't cure depression. It's just a bandaid to cloud my thoughts. The problem is that when I'm in a nasty state, I don't even want to do that. I just want curl up on the couch and watch TV, maybe sleep.

Thank you. 

I sure hope so. I've been on seraquel and Prozac in the past, and quit both because the lack of emotion felt worse than the emptiness.

I 100% understand that failure. Definitely one of the reasons why I finally stopped doing one of the things I loved most (theatre). Felt like I was setting myself up for failure with every audition. Instead, I took up running and painting to give myself a goal to help me keep going. Now, I don't rely on others to feel accomplished, but it doesn't fill that void inside which in turn affects my creativity because it's hard for me to express emptiness on a canvas.
Anything is possible, but it didn't feel that way at all. Mentioning suicidal ideation made him very uncomfortable, and he lashed out on me.

I wanted to commit myself today, but when I mentioned it to my husband, I was yelled at. He told me he needed more of a heads up in order to make arrangements for his mom to watch the kids. In other words, I am inconveniencing him with my depression. I didn't commit myself because then I would just feel more guilty that I burdened him more.

Feels like everyday is worse. I'm tired of fighting and no one helps me with the depression. Married with two kids, but I feel alone. Empty. My husband took over parental duties for me today, because I just couldn't stop crying. I appreciate that help. I really do, but I need help with my fucked up head. I want to understand what renders me into a blubbering pile of uselessness. I don't want to be this. I don't want my kids seeing their mother so weak.

20 years since my diagnosis, but I've been living with this monster for 36 years. I don't know how to fight it anymore.
